_comment: Content Wave C2: Zevara Sunderscale, Oldblood Drake Watch Captain of Liscor, posted at the gate. Canon (wiki.wanderinginn.com/Zevara): light-blue scales, a scar down the left of her jaw, tall; dry, perpetually overworked, rigidly procedural, refuses bribes, no personal life (six weeks' leave in ten years); her Senior Guardsmen are Relc (a [Spearmaster]) and Klbkch (an Antinium). The 'persuade' branch banks persuaded_someone -- the SAME [Diplomat] identity feed watch_crate already produces (classes.json diplomat.gained_by {persuaded_someone:1, heard_gossip:3}); it is one-time via hide_when so it can't re-bank, and its entry sits behind that hide_when so the persuade node is unreachable once banked. The spec's 'gate_guard defers to her' beat is carried on ZEVARA'S side ('authority' node references the guard) rather than by editing gate_guard's dialogue[0]/talk_pool, both of which gate_district_walkthrough + social_loop assert VERBATIM. Opacity rule: class NAME only, no stats.

hub.speaker: Zevara
hub.text: Watch Captain Zevara. If this is a report, keep it short; if it's a complaint, keep it shorter. I've been on since before the gate opened and I'll be on after it shuts.

options.text: Actually — the Watch could help me with something.

shift.speaker: Zevara
shift.text: Ten years of long shifts. Six weeks of leave across all of them — do the arithmetic and then don't ask why I look like this. My Senior Guardsmen are a spearmaster who won't stop talking and an Antinium who won't start, and somehow the wall still stands. Don't tell either of them the streak's holding. They'll take the credit.

options.text: The guard on the gate speaks well of you.
I'll let you get back to it.

authority.speaker: Zevara
authority.text: He should. I signed his posting and I read his reports — both of them, the real one and the one where nothing happened. Liscor's Watch runs on people who'd rather stand a boring gate than let an interesting one through. Long may it bore us.

persuade.speaker: Zevara
persuade.text: Help. From the Watch. That isn't a favour, it's a requisition, and requisitions come with forms. Convince me it's worth the ink.

options.text: If it's under the city and it's moving, it's already Watch business — I'm just the one telling you first.

persuaded.speaker: Zevara
persuaded.text: ...Hm. First sentence anyone's given me today that didn't waste a word. Fine — you've made your case; I'll put eyes on it. And I'll remember you argue clean. That's rarer than you'd think on my side of the gate.
